message: float16 input is upcast to float64, so results are complex128; NumPy and the repo's own float16 helper use float32 (complex64), changing the output dtype and doubling memory
hfft no longer swaps the norm direction before calling irfft, so with norm=None/'forward'/'backward' the scaling is wrong (off by a factor of n) versus numpy.fft.hfft
validation uses n < 0, so n=0 passes through; NumPy raises ValueError for n < 1 (invalid number of data points), off-by-one
rfft2 default axes changed from (-2, -1) to None, which transforms all axes for ndim > 2 and breaks the numpy.fft signature/behaviour (irfft2 still uses (-2, -1))

_install_half_support monkey-patches numpy.fft at import time, globally, without saving originals or providing a restore; interface patching must be explicit, reversible and documented (see mkl_fft.patch)

the float16 test compares against np.fft which the import has just replaced by the same functions (tautological), uses rtol=1e-1 and shape only, and does not cover irfft/hfft or complex dtype/norm cases
bare except swallows every exception (including real errors from asarray/upcast) and silently returns the input
